Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0369 of 2022, under Section 363, 366, 323,
376, 506 IPC, Section 3(2)(v) read with Section 3(2)(v)a of SC/ST Act & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act,
P.S. Jankipuram, District Lucknow.
3.
In terms of the FIR, a missing person report was lodged.

Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that they knew each Abhishek Sharma vs State Ofu.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190970738/
1 other for last more than six months and physical relations were also formed.

entities.text: Abhishek Sharma vs State Ofu.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Deptt.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was stated that the victim had gone with the applicant to Lakhimpur.

A similar statement was recorded by the victim before the medical authorities, however, in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim changed her story and alleged commission of the offence under Section 376 IPC.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner places reliance on various photographs of the applicant with the victim as well as Whatsapp chats, which is in consonance with the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., and the statement made before the medical authorities.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 24.12.2022 and there is no definite document with regard to the age of the victim, which is to be seen at the time of trial, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Abhishek Sharma be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
